sprint: ORGΛNON — Sentinel-Driven Hypothesis Generation (Comprehensive) · Phase 0.1 bar-calibration — REGRESS (broad universe)
statement: REGRESS of Phase 0.1 (user-directed): the headline 20-perp test STOPPED the sprint (bar not proven) with TWO causes — weekly momentum absent/weak AND the bar structurally unprovable on a universe with effective breadth ≈ 2.43 (power floor 5899, even perfect-foresight INSUFFICIENT). This fresh pre-registration BROADENS the universe to give the bar its fairest power test: does higher effective breadth lower the derived floor enough for the yes-path (perfect-foresight) to clear it, and is a real momentum edge detectable across a broad cross-section? Same frozen engine, same construction, same threshold (Rule VII) — ONLY the universe changes. A GO here would REOPEN the sprint; a NO-GO/INSUFFICIENT with the floor still unreachable CONFIRMS the STOP with stronger evidence. No field changes after a result is seen (Rule IX).

regressFrom.priorResult: momentum NO-GO (raw IC t=+1.21, resid≈0, portfolio negative, held-out negative); perfect-foresight INSUFFICIENT (effN 89 ≪ floor 5899); noise NO-GO; verdict hash 37c1ca43c926.
regressFrom.hypothesisUnderTest: the STOP was driven by the 20-perp universe's tiny effective breadth (2.43). If crypto's effective breadth is fundamentally low (one dominant BTC factor), a broad universe will NOT rescue the floor (needs effBreadth ≈ 69) → STOP confirmed. If a broad, more idiosyncratic cross-section lifts effBreadth materially, the yes-path may fire → sprint reopens. Settled empirically.

edge.name: weekly-horizon cross-sectional momentum in liquid crypto perpetuals (broad universe)
edge.description: Identical construction to the headline test, on a BROAD cross-section: assets with higher recent (skip-adjusted) multi-week trailing return earn higher forward WEEKLY return than assets with lower trailing return.
documentedBy: Liu, Y. & Tsyvinski, A. (2021). Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency. RFS 34(6):2689-2727. — crypto momentum at weekly-to-monthly horizons, documented on a BROAD universe (this REGRESS aligns the universe breadth with the literature).
Liu, Y., Tsyvinski, A. & Wu, X. (2022). Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency. JF 77(2):1133-1177.
Jegadeesh & Titman (1993); Jegadeesh (1990) & Lehmann (1990) short-term reversal (the 1-week skip).
edge.notFromData: Construction unchanged from the headline (lookback 56d/skip 7d/holding 7d weekly). Only the universe is broadened, by an OBJECTIVE listing-date rule (below) — not chosen by inspecting momentum results. No parameter tuned to pass.

construction.signalDefinition: signal(t) = close[t-7] / close[t-63] - 1 (56-day cumulative return ending one week before t; most-recent week skipped). Strictly causal. Frozen momentum.build_panels(closes, lookback=56, skip=7, horizon=7).
construction.forwardDefinition: forward(t) = close[t+7] / close[t] - 1 (next-week return, strictly after t).
construction.nonOverlapSampling: decision days sampled at stride 7 from phase 0 → non-overlapping weekly returns. Panel preparation in the runner; edits no frozen file.
construction.crossSectional: at each sampled t, the signal vector across the broad universe is ranked (Spearman IC) vs the forward vector by the frozen discriminator.

universe.rule: Binance USD-M USDT-margined PERPETUAL contracts, status TRADING, ONBOARDED on/before 2023-01-01 (from fapi/v1/exchangeInfo onboardDate), EXCLUDING the synthetic index product BTCDOMUSDT. Chronological, objective, liquidity-agnostic. Survivorship caveat DISCLOSED: exchangeInfo lists currently-trading perps, so perps delisted before 2026 are absent (a mild survivorship filter, same in kind as the original 20 'still-liquid' set); the point of this REGRESS is the BREADTH (effN/effBreadth) test, for which currently-listed long-history perps are the right set. A late-2022-listed asset enters when its checksummed data begins (finite-pairs IC → survivorship-safe within the window).
universe.survivorship: the PRE-REGISTERED set by the objective rule above, not a post-hoc survivor set. No asset added/dropped after seeing results.

window.rationale: 36 monthly checksum-anchored 1d-kline dumps per symbol. Same window as the headline test so only the universe breadth differs. NOT extended after a result.

heldOut.note: held-out forward window the construction never saw; confirm a discovery GO here.

split.boundaryRule: a sampled weekly decision day t is discovery iff its date < 2025-01-01, else held-out.

neutralization.disclosure: identical to the headline — full-sample static (M,K); neutralization only subtracts explanatory power (safe direction). A momentum GO that survives it is residual cross-sectional alpha.

threshold.note: THE ENGINE'S OWN GATES, byte-identical (Rule XXXVIII).
threshold.powerFloor: the derived effective-N floor. The KEY quantity this REGRESS moves: floor = ((tGate+zPower)·se/targetIC)² with se=1/√(effBreadth−3). Broader universe → higher effBreadth → smaller se → lower floor. Whether it drops enough (needs effBreadth ≈ 69) is the empirical question.
threshold.verdictRule: GO requires residual-IC NW-deflated t > 3.0 AND mean > 0.02 AND long-short portfolio t > 2.5 AND portfolio mean > 0 AND effective-N >= derived power floor.

grid.note: single pre-registered construction; no grid → no multiple-testing inflation. The 20-perp result is the PRIOR test (disclosed), this is a fresh universe, not a searched grid over universes.

positive.name: perfect-foresight (forward + tiny noise, non-degenerate)
positive.expectation: GO iff the broad universe's effN clears the (breadth-lowered) floor — THE decisive REGRESS check.

passCondition.barProven: weekly momentum GOes at realistic strength in discovery, adequately powered (effN >= floor), AND survives held-out 2025 — while perfect-foresight GOes and noise NO-GOes. → REOPEN the sprint.
passCondition.stopConfirmed: the floor stays unreachable (perfect-foresight still INSUFFICIENT) OR momentum NO-GOes → STOP confirmed with broad-universe evidence; the bar's power floor vs. crypto's effective breadth is the thing to revisit before any generation.

antiTuning.frozenEngine: ZERO engine changes; the 6 .py + loop wall byte-identical; existing verdicts unchanged.
antiTuning.noPostHocChange: no field changes after a result. If this NO-GOes, the honest terminal is the confirmed STOP — not a third universe fished for a GO.
antiTuning.objectiveUniverse: the universe is defined by an OBJECTIVE listing-date rule, not chosen by peeking at which assets show momentum.
antiTuning.admissibleDataOnly: all-T1 checksum-anchored dumps or the run is void (A3). No paid data.
